messages.author: 57baea85a103d7c2
messages.subject: Re: simple error with getSpeciesImages
parts:
The problem may be with the way you have defined your tags.  

is it similar to the following :

RecTab<-recordTableIndividual(inDir = "/media/kulbushan/_hdd2/Camera Trap Data/Analysis Files/Survival_Analysis/SL_2016",
                      hasStationFolders = FALSE, IDfrom = "metadata", minDeltaTime = '60', deltaTimeComparedTo = "lastIndependentRecord",
                      timeZone = "Asia/Kolkata", stationCol = "Station", writecsv = TRUE, outDir = "/media/kulbushan/_hdd2/Camera Trap Data/Analysis Files/Survival_Analysis/Density_SECR",
                      metadataHierarchyDelimitor = "|", metadataIDTag = "Snow Leopard", removeDuplicateRecords = TRUE)

with SL_2016 containing snow leopard images with tags Snow Leopard/SL_1... Snow_Leopard/SL_2 etc ? if its Species/Snow_Leopard/SL_1 ...etc you will encounter the problem also if metadataHierarcyDelimitor is not set to "|" and if there are spelling differences or spaces.

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: simple error with getSpeciesImages
parts:
Hi,
if possible please always provide the code you ran. It makes it easier to spot the problem.

The error message says:
metadataSpeciesTag 'Snow leopard' not found in image metadata tag 'HierarchicalSubject'.

So apparently you assigned argument metadataSpeciesTag = "Snow leopard". I suspect that it should be something like metadataSpeciesTag = "Species" (depending on how you set up your digiKam tag tree). 
metadataSpeciesTag is the name of the tag group that contains the species labels, not the species label itself. 

See here for an example.
Best,
Jürgen
